mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.order_count),0) orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(s.cancelled_order_count),0) cancelledOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(s.return_count),0) returnCount, COALESCE(SUM(s.gross_minor),0) grossMinor, COALESCE(SUM(s.discount_minor),0) discountMinor, COALESCE(SUM(s.surcharge_minor),0) surchargeMinor, COALESCE(SUM(s.receivable_minor),0) receivableMinor, COALESCE(SUM(s.refund_minor),0) refundMinor, COALESCE(SUM(s.cash_received_minor),0) cashReceivedMinor, COALESCE(SUM(s.cash_refunded_minor),0) cashRefundedMinor, COALESCE(SUM(s.shift_difference_minor),0) shiftDifferenceMinor, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rpt_projection_lineage l WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.store_id=#{storeId} AND l.business_date=#{businessDate} AND l.projection_status='INCOMPLETE') incompleteLineageCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rpt_difference d JOIN rpt_source_event_inbox e ON e.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND e.source_event_id=d.source_event_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.store_id=#{storeId} AND e.business_date=#{businessDate} AND d.state IN ('OPEN','ACKNOWLEDGED')) openDifferenceCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.source_owner) FROM rpt_projection_lineage l WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.store_id=#{storeId} AND l.business_date=#{businessDate} AND l.source_owner IN ('ORDER','SHIFT','PROMOTION','INVENTORY','COSTING')) lineageOwnerCount, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(l.source_sequence) FROM rpt_projection_lineage l WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.store_id=#{storeId} AND l.business_date=#{businessDate}),0) maximumSourceSequence, COALESCE((SELECT r.active_projection_version FROM rpt_projection_registry r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.metric_family='SALES'),'UNAVAILABLE') salesProjectionVersion, COALESCE((SELECT r.active_projection_version FROM rpt_projection_registry r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.metric_family='INVENTORY_COST'),'UNAVAILABLE') inventoryProjectionVersion, 'CNY' currency FROM rpt_projection_registry rr LEFT JOIN rpt_sales_daily s ON s.tenant_id=rr.tenant_id AND s.projection_version=rr.active_projection_version AND s.store_id=#{storeId} AND s.business_date=#{businessDate} WHERE rr.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND rr.metric_family='SALES'
